Container.Name: hue-halloween
Container.Overview:
Halloween light and sound shows for Philips Hue (Entertainment API, ~50 fps) with audio on Sonos or any other Music Assistant player via Home Assistant.
Ships four generated Halloween sets (haunted house, graveyard at midnight, witches' cauldron, storm night) whose lights follow the music and sound effects exactly, an endless "Halloween evening" mode, and an automatic light show generator for your own audio files.
Setup: open the WebUI, press the link button on the Hue bridge, click "Koppeln", pick the entertainment area, run the calibration show and adjust the offset until beep and flash match.
Network must be host (mDNS bridge discovery, and Music Assistant has to fetch the audio from this container). The sets are generated once on first start (1-2 minutes, ~1.5 GB RAM peak).
Container.Requires: Philips Hue bridge (V2 or Pro) with an entertainment area of colour lights, Home Assistant with the Music Assistant integration.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Hue pairing keys and UI settings (settings.json).

Config.Name: Shows Directory
Config.Description: Generated sets and your own shows. Drop audio files here and press 'neu scannen' in the UI to get an automatic light show.

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Home Assistant as reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Media Player
Config.Description: Music Assistant media_player entity that plays the sound. Can be changed in the UI.

Config.Name: Playback Mode
Config.Description: announce = music_assistant.play_announcement (pauses and resumes what was playing), media = media_player.play_media. Can be changed in the UI.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. URL under which Music Assistant fetches the audio, e.g. http://192.168.0.20:8099. Empty = auto-detected server IP.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port of the WebUI and the audio server (host network). If changed, adjust the WebUI link.
